close_reason: False positive: all config tests already have #[serial] attribute and serial_test is in dev-deps. The SAFETY comments document the serialization guarantee.
description:
## Why this issue exists

kithd/src/config.rs has tests that call `unsafe { std::env::set_var(...) }` and `unsafe { std::env::remove_var(...) }` to exercise `Config::from_env()`. Cargo runs tests in parallel threads within the same process by default. Because the process environment is a single global resource, two test threads setting different values for the same variable (e.g. `KITH_BLOB_DIR`) race with each other, producing non-deterministic results and occasional spurious failures.

## What needs to be done

Add `#[serial_test::serial]` (or equivalent) to every test function in config.rs that writes to the process environment. Add `serial_test` to `[dev-dependencies]` in kithd/Cargo.toml. Alternatively, refactor `Config::from_env()` to accept an explicit env map (e.g. `HashMap<String,String>`) so tests can pass isolated state without touching the real environment at all — this is the more robust fix.

## Acceptance criteria

- `cargo test -p kithd config` passes reliably when run with `--test-threads=8`
- No test function in config.rs mutates the process environment without serialization or isolation
title: config tests race on process env without serial guard
